title: PHP 7.4 is end-of-life and no longer receives security patches
severitySource: PHP supported versions policy / Harbor SEC-PHP-01
summary: PHP 7.4 reached official end of life on 28 November 2022. Any application still executing on 7.4 is running an unsupported runtime. A source-code edit cannot patch the interpreter.
remediation: Upgrade the runtime, Composer platform pin, and CI PHP version to a currently supported release (8.2 or 8.3 for this demo). Keep application source unchanged unless a compatibility check fails.
